what_is_closed: At zeta=-beta, -1<beta<0, the exact Jordan identities are M*A=-A+B, M*B=-B, M*C=-C.
For K_A=sqrt(1+beta^2), K_B=sqrt(2), the printed Eq. (74) generalized-mode coefficient has ODE residual exp(-xi)*sigma1*(1/K_B-1/K_A)*B.
Replacing only xi*B/K_B by xi*B/K_A gives an ODE-consistent chain with exact 30x30 determinant 4/(abs(beta)^26*(1+beta^2)^5)>1/8 throughout -1<beta<0.
The printed Eq. (90) determinant and corrected determinant have a closed-form ratio, reproduced independently by the registered full boundary matrix.

equation_or_mapping.confluent_derivation: lim(abs(det(C_generic))/abs(lambda_2-lambda_1)^10)=1/(8*abs(beta)^26); the normalized generalized mode tends to (A+B/2)/sqrt(2), while the companion mode tends to B/sqrt(2). Transforming this pair to (A/K_A,B/K_B) multiplies the determinant by (sqrt(2)/K_A)^10, giving 4/(abs(beta)^26*(1+beta^2)^5).
equation_or_mapping.strict_lower_bound: For a=abs(beta) in (0,1), a^26*(1+a^2)^5<32, hence the corrected determinant is strictly greater than 1/8.
